questions.q: What are the four beautiful questions?
a: Why, Why not, What if, How
What if, So what, Now what, Then what

questions.q: What does lesson 1 say happens to curiosity at school?
a: Most of it is lost as facts and tests take priority

questions.q: What kind of question is 'why?' according to lesson 2?
a: A naive, child-like question that helps you get smarter

questions.q: What does asking 'why not?' help you do?
a: Question 'the way it's always been done' and find solutions
